source_selection.policy: lowest eligible training seed in the archived verified q256 fixed-baseline 256-kimg source manifest

batch_construction.generator: direct torch.randperm with one CPU torch.Generator manually seeded by audit_minibatch_id per batch

finite_difference_calibration_boundary: epsilon grids were revised using only arm A, audit batch 2026082601, direction 0 correctness smokes before the formal matrix; the 5% gate was not relaxed and all failed smokes are retained
jvp_direction_convention: per-tensor Gaussian with RMS=max(state RMS,1e-3); positive-state coordinates are elementwise clipped to remain positive under the largest frozen epsilon
matrix: 4 arms x 4 fixed audit minibatches x 8 fixed random projection directions x 4 horizons
